author: pacoaK4351PD

title: Essential if you are in Granada and really want to relax
text: It is our place of rest and relaxation of reference in Granada. The whole team has incredible sensitivity and hands. It's just you're out after two hours floating! We chose one Ritual Boreal dream and it was amazing. The room very nice and private for the two of us where we could have cava and had some chocolates while we were in the whirlpool. The subsequent 50’ massage left us almost asleep from how relaxed we were.
author: M3624ANtaniar

title: Wonderful experience as a couple
text: The first time they make us such a complete massage, magnificent treatment of the staff, very attentive at all times, a perfect space to disconnect and enjoy as a couple, they personalize the massage and adapt it to your needs, in addition to advising and giving recommendations to improve back pains etc.. I would definitely repeat, Thank you very much!!!!!
author: Freedom63295153755

title: Outstanding experience in every way
text: We were two friends and we both thought the same. The two hours we were there we flew by! They gave us everything we needed for the Jacuzzi and served us very rich tea and chocolates. Unbelievable the detail it has in the treatment of the public, since they attend you by phone (in our case by Michelangelo) as the two masseurs who attended us (forgive me but I do not remember the name of the boy and the girl). Special attention to the cleanliness of the premises. Out of 10 everything.
author: M3624ANtaniar

title: Wonderful massage
text: The best in Granada without a doubt. The staff is very professional and qualified, they are very attentive and friendly. I recommend it 100%!!! Chelo attended me in several sessions and I loved it but in reality they are all great.
author: 734zinebt

title: An activity that you should not miss in Granada
text: We loved the experience. Very positive to highlight the cleanliness and friendliness of the center. It really is what it says, an urban spa with total privacy. Only our hosts entered and both Chelo and Natalia made us spend an incredible and very refreshing afternoon. Thanks team!
author: pacoaK4351PD

title: New BorealDream Ritual.
text:
Like every time I go to Granada, I always stop by BorealRelax and they are always excellent in customer service and with their incredible massages.
This time we tried the new BorealDream Ritual and I was amazed.
Thank you very much for all the dedication and affection you always give.
100% recommended.
author: Jose Mari P

title: The best option to relax in Granada
text: I let myself be recommended by the center staff and tried the BorealDreams Ritual. It was wonderful. The bathroom in the Jacuzzi, with nature images, ambient light and relaxing music plus the 80 minute massage. I have come out completely new and on top of that they are pet friendly! 100% recommended
author: Sightsee46287773093
